argv:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$proc=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "name='chrome.exe'" | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*--remote-debugging-port=17410*' } | Select-Object -First 1
if(-not $proc){ throw 'Chrome debug 17410 process not found' }
$cmd=[string]$proc.CommandLine
$profilePath=''
if($cmd -match '--user-data-dir=(?:"([^"]+)"|([^\s]+))'){ $profilePath=if($Matches[1]){$Matches[1]}else{$Matches[2]} }
if(-not $profilePath){ throw 'user-data-dir not found' }
$histCandidates=@(
  (Join-Path $profilePath 'Default\History'),
  (Join-Path $profilePath 'History')
)
$hist=$histCandidates | Where-Object { Test-Path -LiteralPath $_ } | Select-Object -First 1
if(-not $hist){ throw "History not found under $profilePath" }
$tmp='E:\WebAIBridge\.tmp-history-17410.db'
Copy-Item -LiteralPath $hist -Destination $tmp -Force
$py=@'
import sqlite3, json
ids=[
"6abda62d-8198-83ed-aaa2-40b16f96a8a0",
"6abda64b-aac4-83eb-adee-dc7143ca5d2b",
"6abf3eb2-40ec-83eb-9f7f-c4a32ad11fc0",
"6abda61c-a440-83ed-9482-1d0fc7923e03",
]
db=r"E:\WebAIBridge\.tmp-history-17410.db"
con=sqlite3.connect(db)
out={}
for cid in ids:
    rows=con.execute("select url,title,last_visit_time from urls where url like ? order by last_visit_time desc limit 20",('%'+cid+'%',)).fetchall()
    out[cid]=[{"url":r[0],"title":r[1]} for r in rows]
print(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False))
con.close()
'@
$result=$py | python -
Remove-Item -LiteralPath $tmp -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
[pscustomobject]@{profilePath=$profilePath;matches=($result|ConvertFrom-Json)} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 -Compress

note: Read-only recover exact project chat URLs from Chrome history
